title: 第527章 天命之劫第526章 光影和解
lines: 晨昏之原的和解庆典仍在继续，万族欢腾，但云澈的心神，已完全被那源自天命神台的古老召唤所牵引。
这召唤并非实质的声音，而是一种源自灵魂深处、与体内天命种子共鸣的强烈悸动，仿佛在催促他，前往某个命运交汇之地，去接受最终的考验，摘取那“天命”
的果实。
他知道，突破天命至尊的时机，就在此刻！
向光族至尊、幽影族长、光璃等人匆匆传音告别，甚至来不及详细解释，云澈便在无数道惊讶、不解的目光中，化作一道融合了银灰时光、淡金光明、幽邃暗影的奇异流光，冲天而起，循着那股冥冥中的召唤感，以刚刚领悟尚未纯熟的“光速时光”
身法，将速度提升到极致，撕裂虚空，向着感应中那片不可知、不可测的维度疾驰而去。
他没有返回人族疆域，也没有去任何已知的秘境。
天命神台的召唤，指引的是一条超脱于常规时空的道路。
他在无尽的虚无与时空乱流中穿行，不知岁月，不辨方向，唯有体内天命种子的光芒越来越炽盛，与远方那古老存在的共鸣越来越清晰。
不知过了多久，也许是一瞬，也许是万年，前方无尽的虚无之中，一点微光亮起。
那光芒起初微弱，却带着一种凌驾于万物之上的威严与古老，仿佛是一切规则的源头，一切命运的起点。
随着靠近，那点微光迅速扩大，最终化为一座无法用语言形容其宏伟、其古老的巨大神台轮廓。
正是他曾见过的——天命神台！
但此刻的神台，与当初赐予种子时那投影般的姿态截然不同。
它真实地矗立在这片虚无的尽头，通体仿佛由混沌初开时的原始规则凝聚而成，散发着镇压万古、统御诸天的无上气息。
神台周围，无数大道符文生灭，亿万星辰虚影环绕，时间长河在其脚下流淌，命运丝线在其周围交织。
神台之上，空空荡荡，唯有一片混沌。
但云澈能感觉到，那里存在着一个无法言喻的伟大意志——天道的意志！
或者说，是这方万族星域宇宙本源规则的显化！
召唤的源头，就在那里。
云澈深吸一口气，压下心中的激动与一丝本能的敬畏，一步步，踏上了通往神台的阶梯。
每踏出一步，身上的压力便沉重一分，仿佛有无形的目光在审视着他的灵魂、他的道基、他过往的一切。
那是天道的拷问，无关善恶，只关乎“道”
与“心”
终于，他登上了神台之巅，立于那片混沌之前。
“汝，得天命种子，承万民愿力，行功德之事，已具承载天命之基。”
一道宏大、漠然、仿佛由无数法则之音组合而成的意念，直接在云澈灵魂深处响起，正是那冥冥中的天道意志，“然，天命何谓？汝，何以承天命？”
拷问，开始了。
这不是雷霆劫罚，而是直指本心的道心之问！
若答案不能让天道意志认可，便是道心崩溃，身死道消，比任何天劫都更加凶险。
云澈静立，银眸之中，时光长河虚影浮现，倒映着他一路走来的历程：从微末崛起，历经生死，观悟轮回，游历万族，学光之璀璨，悟暗之深邃，融百家之长，纳万民之愿……最终，促光暗之和，引万族之庆。
他缓缓开口，声音不高，却清晰坚定，仿佛在陈述一个再自然不过的真理，又仿佛在与这方宇宙的本源对话：
“天命，非一人之私欲，非强权之枷锁，亦非既定之轨迹。”
“晚辈云澈所见，所谓天命，乃众生意志之汇聚，是文明延续之内在规律，是万物生长、星河流转、兴衰更替背后，那无形的推力与选择。”
“光族求秩序，暗族寻平衡，木族主生机，冥族掌死寂……万族万象，道路万千，皆有其道，皆有其理。
天命非独钟一道，而在万道并行，共生共存。
昔日光暗对立，内耗不断，宇宙失衡，此非天命所愿。
content_en:
The reconciliation celebration in the Land of Dawn and Dusk is still going on, and all races are rejoicing, but Yun Che’s mind has been completely attracted by the ancient call originating from the Destiny Platform.
This call is not a substantive voice, but a strong throbbing originating from the depths of his soul that resonates with the seeds of destiny in his body, as if urging him to go to a place where fate intersects, to accept the final test, and to pick up the "destiny"
of fruit.
He knew that the time to break through to the Supreme Destiny was now!
Yun Che hurriedly sent a message to say goodbye to the Supreme Leader of the Light Clan, the Shadow Clan Leader, Guang Li and others. Without even having time to explain in detail, Yun Che turned into a strange stream of silver-gray time, pale gold light, and deep shadows in the face of countless surprised and puzzled eyes. It rose into the sky, following the mysterious feeling of calling, and used the "speed of light" that he had just comprehended but had not yet mastered.
The movement technique increases the speed to the extreme, tears the void, and rushes towards the unknowable and unfathomable dimension in the induction.
He did not return to the human territory, nor did he go to any known secret realm.
The call from the Destiny Platform guides a path beyond conventional time and space.
He traveled through the endless void and turbulent flow of time and space, not knowing the time and direction. Only the light of the destiny seeds in his body became more and more blazing, and the resonance with the ancient existence in the distance became clearer and clearer.
I don’t know how long it took, maybe it was a moment, maybe it was ten thousand years, and in the endless nothingness ahead, a little light lit up.
The light was weak at first, but it carried a majesty and antiquity that towered over all things, as if it were the source of all rules and the starting point of all destiny.
As it got closer, the glimmer of light quickly expanded, eventually turning into the outline of a huge shrine whose majesty and antiquity could not be described in words.
It was exactly what he had seen before - the Divine Platform of Destiny!
But the altar at this moment is completely different from the projection-like posture when the seeds were given.
It truly stands at the end of this void, and its entire body seems to be condensed from the original rules when chaos first emerged. It exudes the supreme aura that suppresses eternity and governs the heavens.
Around the altar, countless runes of the avenue are born and died, surrounded by the shadows of billions of stars, the river of time flows at its feet, and the threads of fate are intertwined around it.
Above the altar, there was nothing but chaos.
But Yun Che can feel that there is an indescribable great will there - the will of heaven!
In other words, it is the manifestation of the original rules of the universe in this starry domain!
The source of the call is right there.
Yun Che took a deep breath, suppressed the excitement and a hint of instinctive awe in his heart, and stepped onto the stairs leading to the altar step by step.
Every time he took a step, the pressure on his body became heavier, as if there were invisible eyes examining his soul, his foundation, and everything in his past.
That is the torture of heaven, it has nothing to do with good or evil, it is only about "Tao"
and "heart"
Finally, he reached the top of the altar and stood in front of the chaos.
"You have received the seeds of destiny, inherited the wishes of all people, and performed meritorious deeds. You have the foundation to carry the destiny."
A grand, indifferent idea that seemed to be composed of the sounds of countless laws sounded directly in the depths of Yun Che's soul. It was the will of heaven in the dark, "But, what is destiny? Why do you inherit destiny?"
The torture began.
This is not a thunderbolt punishment, but a question from the Taoist heart that points directly to the heart!
If the answer cannot be recognized by the will of Heaven, then the heart of Dao will collapse and the body will die and the Dao will disappear, which is more dangerous than any heavenly disaster.
Yun Che stood quietly, with the shadow of the long river of time emerging in his silver eyes, reflecting his journey along the way: rising from the humble beginning, experiencing life and death, understanding reincarnation, traveling to all races, learning the brilliance of light, realizing the depth of darkness, integrating the strengths of hundreds of families, accepting the wishes of all people... In the end, promoting the harmony of light and darkness, and leading to the celebration of all races.
He spoke slowly, his voice not high, but clear and firm, as if he was stating a natural truth, and as if he was talking to the origin of this universe:
"Destiny is not one person's selfish desires, nor the shackles of power, nor a predetermined trajectory."
"Junior Yun Che has seen that the so-called destiny is the convergence of the will of all living beings. It is the inherent law of the continuation of civilization. It is the invisible force and choice behind the growth of all things, the rotation of stars and rivers, and the rise and fall of life."
"The Light Clan seeks order, the Dark Clan seeks balance, the Wood Clan controls vitality, and the Nether Clan controls death... All races and phenomena, and countless paths, all have their own ways and reasons.
Destiny is not exclusive to one thing, but exists in all directions, coexisting and coexisting.
In the past, light and darkness were in opposition, internal friction was constant, and the universe was out of balance. This was not what destiny intended.
title_en: Chapter 527: The Calamity of Destiny Chapter 526: Reconciliation of Light and Shadow
